findings.title: Duplicate mutationFn in useMarkAttendance is a compile error
findings.summary: Two mutationFn keys in the same object literal: first calls api.post (wrong method), second calls apiPatch (correct). TypeScript strict mode emits TS2300 duplicate identifier. Fix: remove the first mutationFn line entirely.

findings.title: <Textarea> component does not exist — Screen 7 review dialog will fail to compile
findings.summary: components/ui/textarea.tsx does not exist (verified by directory listing). The design defers the choice to the coder. Design must commit: either add the shadcn textarea component or specify the exact native <textarea> fallback with className.

findings.title: apiPatch declared after the hooks that call it in features/attendance/hooks.ts
findings.where: features/attendance/hooks.ts (§9) — apiPatch const at ~line 180, called by useMarkAttendance at ~line 130
findings.summary: apiPatch is a const declaration placed after the hook functions that call it, diverging from the features/classes/hooks.ts and features/academics/hooks.ts pattern. Move apiPatch + API_BASE to the top of the file, immediately after imports.

findings.title: todayISO() documented as 'local time' but uses toISOString() which returns UTC
findings.where: §12 (Utility Helpers) and Screen 5 client-side faculty filter
findings.summary: new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10) returns UTC date, not local date. Comment says 'local time'. For users in UTC+ timezones, sessions disappear early. Design must state a definitive choice: keep UTC (and fix the comment to say UTC, matching server storage) or use local date construction.

findings.title: Screen 2 assign button uses non-existent permission key classes.assignments.manage
findings.where: Screen 2 (Section Detail), Faculty tab assign button (§10/Screen 2)
findings.summary: Design shows <Can permission="classes.assignments.manage" anyOf={["classes.faculty.assign"]}> then immediately notes the key does not exist. Since Can checks permission first and ignores anyOf, the button never renders. Remove the invalid snippet; show only <Can permission="classes.faculty.assign">.

findings.title: Sessions hooks enabled gate includes attendance.mark but GET /sessions requires attendance.view
findings.summary: API contract confirms GET /api/attendance/sessions and GET /api/attendance/sessions/:id require attendance.view (not attendance.mark). Enabling the query for attendance.mark-only users triggers a 403. Design must either document that mark-only roles also hold view, or add explicit 403 handling, or restrict enabled to attendance.view only.

findings.title: No timetable list/index page — useCreateTimetable hook has no callsite
findings.summary: Only a timetable detail page [id]/page.tsx is specified; no timetable list/index page. useCreateTimetable() is exported but never called by any screen. Design must either add a list page with CreateTimetableDialog, add the dialog to Section Detail's Timetable tab, or explicitly mark useCreateTimetable as forward-declared dead code.

findings.title: CreateSessionDialog in Screen 5 is mentioned but never specified
findings.where: Screen 5 (Attendance Sessions List), Open Session row action (§10/Screen 5)
findings.summary: The design says 'Opens a CreateSessionDialog' but provides no dialog spec: no field list, no error mapping for 403/404/409 responses, no success handler. Equivalent gap to prior F10 (Screen 2 AssignFacultyDialog error mapping, originally HIGH). Needs a complete dialog specification.

findings.title: hooks.ts includes 'use client' directive then contradictory comment saying it is not required
findings.summary: The directive and comment contradict each other. Remove the "use client"; line from hooks.ts files (matching features/academics/hooks.ts which does not have it).

findings.title: FacultyAssignment.updatedAt declared required but comment says it may be absent
findings.summary: updatedAt: string with comment 'may not be present in all API responses'. API contract does not list updatedAt on FacultyAssignment. Either type as updatedAt?: string or remove the field. Do not declare required and comment optional.
